audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar priestly-Levitical duties, gifts, firstborn, and tithes text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for sanctuary responsibility, priestly boundaries, Levite service, holy-food portions, firstborn redemption, covenant of salt, no-land inheritance, tithes as service support, and tithe of the tithe. Anti-clerical-abuse and labor-justice safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Aaron, You and your sons and house of your father with you shall bear iniquity/responsibility of sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear iniquity/responsibility of your priesthood.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

modern.text: So the LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your father’s house must bear the iniquity involving the sanctuary. And you and your sons alone must bear the iniquity involving your priesthood.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבֵית אָבִ֨יךָ֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: Also your brothers, tribe of Levi, tribe of your father, bring near with you, that they may join you and minister to you, while you and your sons with you are before tent of testimony.

familiar.text: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

modern.text: But bring with you also your brothers from the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may join you and assist you and your sons before the Tent of the Testimony.

original.text: וְגַ֣ם אֶת אַחֶיךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֨יךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔ךְ וְיִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖יךָ וִֽישָׁרְת֑וּךָ וְאַתָּה֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִתָּ֔ךְ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת

verses.restored: They shall keep your charge and charge of all tent, but to vessels of holy place and to altar they shall not draw near, so neither they nor you die.

familiar.text: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

modern.text: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties of the Tent; but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.

original.text: וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּךָ֔ וּמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל הָאֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל כְּלֵ֨י הַקֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְלֹֽא יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם הֵ֖ם גַּם אַתֶּֽם

verses.restored: They shall join you and keep charge of tent of meeting for all service of tent; an outsider shall not draw near to you.

familiar.text: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

modern.text: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work at the Tent; but no outsider may come near you.

original.text: וְנִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔יךָ וְשָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל וְזָ֖ר לֹא יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall keep charge of holy place and charge of altar, so wrath may no longer be upon children of Israel.

familiar.text: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

modern.text: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and of the altar, so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites again.

original.text: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד קֶ֖צֶף עַל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Look, I myself have taken your brothers, Levites, from midst of children of Israel; to you they are given as gift to YHWH, to serve service of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ אֶת אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִתּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood concerning every matter of altar and from within veil, and you shall serve; service of priesthood I give you as gift, and outsider who draws near shall die.

familiar.text: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

modern.text: But only you and your sons shall attend to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil, and you are to perform that service. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift, but any outsider who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death.” Offerings for Priests and Levites

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֣יךָ אִ֠תְּךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֜ם לְכָל דְּבַ֧ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּלְמִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹ֖כֶת וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְכֶ֔ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Aaron, Look, I myself have given you charge of my contributions, all holy things of children of Israel; to you I have given them as anointed portion and to your sons as age-long due.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “Behold, I have put you in charge of My offerings. As for all the sacred offerings of the Israelites, I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute.

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֒ וַאֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֔ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑י לְכָל קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְךָ֨ נְתַתִּ֧ים לְמָשְׁחָ֛ה וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ לְחָק עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: This shall be yours from Holy of Holies things, from fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering, every sin/purification offering, and every guilt/reparation offering that they return to me; Holy of Holies it shall be for you and your sons.

familiar.text: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

modern.text: A portion of the most holy offerings reserved from the fire will be yours. From all the offerings they render to Me as most holy offerings, whether grain offerings or sin offerings or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.

original.text: זֶֽה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ מִקֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן הָאֵ֑שׁ כָּל קָ֠רְבָּנָם לְֽכָל מִנְחָתָ֞ם וּלְכָל חַטָּאתָ֗ם וּלְכָל אֲשָׁמָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּלְבָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: As Holy of Holies you shall eat it; every male shall eat it; holy it shall be to you.

familiar.text: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

modern.text: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.

original.text: בְּקֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ כָּל זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔וֹ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה לָּֽךְ

verses.restored: This also is yours: contribution of their gift, with all wave offerings of children of Israel; I have given them to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you as age-long due; everyone clean in your house may eat it.

familiar.text: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

modern.text: And this is yours as well: the offering of their gifts, along with all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I have given this to you and your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat it.

original.text: וְזֶה לְּךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ם לְכָל תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗ים וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק עוֹלָ֑ם כָּל טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽוֹ

verses.restored: All best of oil, and all best of new wine and grain, their firstfruits that they give to YHWH, I have given to you.

familiar.text: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.

modern.text: I give you all the freshest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain that the Israelites give to the LORD as their firstfruits.

original.text: כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְכָל חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְדָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽים

verses.restored: First ripe produce of all that is in their land, which they bring to YHWH, shall be yours; everyone clean in your house may eat it.

familiar.text: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

modern.text: The firstfruits of everything in their land that they bring to the LORD will belong to you. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat them.

original.text: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּאַרְצָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר יָבִ֥יאוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כָּל טָה֥וֹר בְּבֵיתְךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.

familiar.text: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

modern.text: Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to you.

original.text: כָּל חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Every opening of womb from all flesh that they bring near to YHWH, among human and among beast, shall be yours; only you shall surely redeem firstborn human, and firstborn unclean beast you shall redeem.

familiar.text: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

modern.text: The firstborn of every womb, whether man or beast, that is offered to the LORD belongs to you. But you must surely redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.

original.text: כָּל פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽכָל בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֛ה בָּאָדָ֥ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכ֣וֹר הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְאֵ֛ת בְּכֽוֹר הַבְּהֵמָ֥ה הַטְּמֵאָ֖ה תִּפְדֶּֽה

verses.restored: Those to be redeemed, from one month old you shall redeem by your valuation, five shekels of silver by sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs it is.

familiar.text: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

modern.text: You are to pay the redemption price for a month-old male according to your valuation: five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.

original.text: וּפְדוּיָו֙ מִבֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֨רְכְּךָ֔ כֶּ֛סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הֽוּא

verses.restored: But firstborn ox, firstborn sheep, or firstborn goat you shall not redeem; they are holy. Their blood you shall dash against altar, and their fat you shall turn into smoke as fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

modern.text: But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat; they are holy. You are to sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

original.text: אַ֣ךְ בְּֽכוֹר שׁ֡וֹר אֽוֹ בְכ֨וֹר כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֽוֹ בְכ֥וֹר עֵ֛ז לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑ם אֶת דָּמָ֞ם תִּזְרֹ֤ק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וְאֶת חֶלְבָּ֣ם תַּקְטִ֔יר אִשֶּׁ֛ה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Their flesh shall be yours; as breast of wave offering and right thigh, it shall be yours.

familiar.text: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

modern.text: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.

original.text: וּבְשָׂרָ֖ם יִהְיֶה לָּ֑ךְ כַּחֲזֵ֧ה הַתְּנוּפָ֛ה וּכְשׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִ֖ין לְךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: All contributions of holy things that children of Israel lift up to YHWH I have given to you, to your sons, and to your daughters with you as age-long due; covenant of salt, age-long, it is before YHWH for you and your seed with you.

familiar.text: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

modern.text: All the holy offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and to your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. It is a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for you and your offspring.”

original.text: כֹּ֣ל תְּרוּמֹ֣ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ימוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְךָ֗ וּלְבָנֶ֧יךָ וְלִבְנֹתֶ֛יךָ אִתְּךָ֖ לְחָק עוֹלָ֑ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח עוֹלָ֥ם הִוא֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אִתָּֽךְ

verses.restored: YHWH said to Aaron, In their land you shall have no inheritance, and portion you shall not have in their midst; I am your portion and your inheritance in midst of children of Israel.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן בְּאַרְצָם֙ לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל וְחֵ֕לֶק לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְךָ֙ וְנַחֲלָ֣תְךָ֔ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: To sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel as inheritance in return for their service that they serve, service of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: Behold, I have given to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work they do, the service of the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְלִבְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי כָּל מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְנַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁר הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Children of Israel shall no longer draw near to tent of meeting to bear sin/misalignment and die.

familiar.text: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

modern.text: No longer may the Israelites come near to the Tent of Meeting, or they will incur guilt and die.

original.text: וְלֹא יִקְרְב֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לָשֵׂ֥את חֵ֖טְא לָמֽוּת

verses.restored: Levites shall serve service of tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity/responsibility; age-long statute throughout generations. In midst of children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

familiar.text: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

modern.text: The Levites are to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting, and they must bear their iniquity. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come. The Levites will not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.

original.text: וְעָבַ֨ד הַלֵּוִ֜י ה֗וּא אֶת עֲבֹדַת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְהֵ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּבְתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה

verses.restored: For tithe of children of Israel, which they lift up to YHWH as contribution, I have given to Levites as inheritance; therefore I said to them, In midst of children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

familiar.text: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

modern.text: For I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites present to the LORD as a contribution. That is why I told them that they would not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.”

original.text: כִּ֞י אֶת מַעְשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤ימוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ תְּרוּמָ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי לַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה עַל כֵּן֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָהֶ֔ם בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD instructed Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: To Levites you shall speak and say to them: When you take from children of Israel tithe that I have given you from them as your inheritance, you shall lift up from it contribution to YHWH, a tithe from tithe.

familiar.text: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.

modern.text: “Speak to the Levites and tell them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.

original.text: וְאֶל הַלְוִיִּ֣ם תְּדַבֵּר֮ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶם֒ כִּֽי תִ֠קְחוּ מֵאֵ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָכֶ֛ם מֵאִתָּ֖ם בְּנַחֲלַתְכֶ֑ם וַהֲרֵמֹתֶ֤ם מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִן הַֽמַּעֲשֵֽׂר

verses.restored: Your contribution shall be counted to you as grain from threshing floor and as fullness from winepress.

familiar.text: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

modern.text: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

original.text: וְנֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָכֶ֖ם תְּרוּמַתְכֶ֑ם כַּדָּגָן֙ מִן הַגֹּ֔רֶן וְכַֽמְלֵאָ֖ה מִן הַיָּֽקֶב

verses.restored: Thus you also shall lift up contribution to YHWH from all your tithes that you take from children of Israel; from it you shall give contribution of YHWH to Aaron the priest.

familiar.text: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.

modern.text: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.

original.text: כֵּ֣ן תָּרִ֤ימוּ גַם אַתֶּם֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְח֔וּ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן

verses.restored: From all your gifts you shall lift up every contribution of YHWH, from all its best, its holy part from it.

familiar.text: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

modern.text: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’

original.text: מִכֹּל֙ מַתְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תָּרִ֕ימוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מִכָּל חֶלְבּ֔וֹ אֶֽת מִקְדְּשׁ֖וֹ מִמֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: You shall say to them: When you lift up its best from it, it shall be counted to Levites as produce of threshing floor and produce of winepress.

familiar.text: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

modern.text: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.

original.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֤ם אֶת חֶלְבּוֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנֶחְשַׁב֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם כִּתְבוּאַ֥ת גֹּ֖רֶן וְכִתְבוּאַ֥ת יָֽקֶב

verses.restored: You may eat it in every place, you and your household, for it is your wages in return for your service in tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּכָל מָק֔וֹם אַתֶּ֖ם וּבֵֽיתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי שָׂכָ֥ר הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם חֵ֥לֶף עֲבֹֽדַתְכֶ֖ם בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: You shall bear no sin/misalignment because of it when you lift up its best from it; holy things of children of Israel you shall not profane, and you shall not die.

familiar.text: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

modern.text: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’”

original.text: וְלֹֽא תִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא בַּהֲרִֽימְכֶ֥ם אֶת חֶלְבּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאֶת קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ

translation_notes: 'Bear the iniquity' of sanctuary/priesthood describes accountable responsibility for sacred service, not permission to transfer blame onto vulnerable people.
Priests and Levites have distinct, interdependent roles; neither group is presented as having unlimited authority.
Sons and daughters share several household holy-food portions when ritually clean.
Firstborn human beings are redeemed rather than sacrificed.

Priests and Levites receive food and tithes because they have no territorial inheritance and perform communal service; this support structure must not become clerical extraction or prosperity theology.
Levites themselves owe a tithe from the tithe and must offer its best, preserving reciprocal accountability.
Death warnings are severe ancient sanctuary-boundary material and must not authorize modern lethal gatekeeping.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 18 to defend clerical entitlement, financial exploitation, hereditary superiority, exclusion from ordinary accountability, or violence against religious outsiders. Sacred workers receive support as wages for service and remain responsible to offer the best of what they receive.
